content.short: Spend BTC, ETH, SOL and stablecoins anywhere Visa is accepted with RedotPay's crypto cards and payments app.
content.description: RedotPay turns crypto balances into everyday spending. Users top up with stablecoins or major coins, then pay with virtual or physical Visa cards at a vast number of merchants worldwide, including through a dedicated Solana card. The app also handles cross-border transfers, P2P trading and multi-currency balances. Deposits are accepted on Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Tron, Polygon, Arbitrum and Bitcoin. Beyond the card, the app now supports scan-to-pay, mobile top-ups, credit, swaps and an earn product, with a separate RedotPay Pro tier and a business offering.
content.meta: Spend crypto and stablecoins with Visa cards, plus transfers and P2P trading in one app. Explore RedotPay on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
